name: &fWatchman Orrin
title: &e&lCRIMSON ISLE
lines: &fWelcome to the Crimson Isle, traveller. Mind the heat.
&fTwo powers squabble over this rock: the Mages of Carmine Spire to the east...
&f...and the Barbarians of Drakehold to the west. Pledge to one and they will give you work.
&fType &a/crimson &fany time to see your standing, your quests and the mini-boss timers.
&fOnce you've pledged, come and see me each day for a week - I'll vouch for you with your faction.

name: &6Warchief Grathe
title: &c&lBARBARIANS
lines: &fHah! Another soft-skinned wanderer.
&fDrakehold takes anyone who can swing an axe and doesn't flinch at a little fire.
&fBring down the mages' champions and the beasts of this isle, and you'll earn our respect.

name: &5Archmage Seraphine
title: &d&lMAGES
lines: &fAh. You have the look of someone with potential.
&fCarmine Spire rewards discipline, study... and results.
&fHelp us keep the barbarian rabble in check and the order will remember your name.

name: &fQuartermaster Hrolf
title: &c&lFACTION SHOP
lines: &fOnly sworn Drakeholders trade here. Show me your standing.

name: &fArcanist Vela
title: &d&lFACTION SHOP
lines: &fThe order's armoury opens only to its members. Let me see your standing.

name: &fSensei Kiyoshi
title: &e&lDOJO
lines: &fStrength is common. Control is rare.
&fSeven trials wait in my dojo. Earn points in each and you will earn a belt.
&fStep into the arena when you are ready.

name: &fForgemaster Ignatius
title: &6&lARMOR PRESTIGE
lines: &fCrimson-forged plate grows stronger with every hunt it survives.
&fBring me Crimson Essence and Leviathan teeth and I will raise its prestige.

name: &fDockhand Nell
title: &c&lLEVIATHAN'S HOLLOW
lines: &fThis is where crews set out to hunt the Magma Leviathan.
&fThe lava's too restless right now - the hunts aren't running yet.
&fGrab a key from a faction envoy in the meantime. You'll want one when the hunts begin.

name: &fCoffer-keeper Mordaunt
title: &6&lBANK
lines: &fDrakehold keeps your coins safer than any mage would.

name: &fTreasurer Lucienne
title: &6&lBANK
lines: &fYour savings, ledgered and warded.

name: &fTrader Kolm
title: &6&lBAZAAR
lines: &fBuy cheap, sell dear - even out here.

name: &fBroker Amaranth
title: &6&lBAZAAR
lines: &fThe market reaches even the Spire.

name: &fOld Bjarka
lines: &fThey say the skull in the square came from a dragon my grandfather's grandfather killed.
&fTruth is, he found it. Still makes a good story.
&fWatch the Dukedom to the south-west. The Duke never stays dead for long.

name: &fApprentice Lio
lines: &fI'm supposed to be studying ember runes. Don't tell the Archmage.
&fThe Rogue Pyromancer used to be one of us. Now he haunts the Courtyard south of here.
&fIf you see him, a few of the order's mages pay well for proof he's been put down.
